title: LaTeX source and verification code for the paper Torsion D-Brane Charges from H-Flux on Calabi-Yau Threefolds
description: LaTeX source (tex/main.tex, main.pdf) and the exact verification script (code/twisted_k.py, with its output code/results.json) of the paper Torsion D-Brane Charges from H-Flux on Calabi-Yau Threefolds. The script computes the twisted K-groups of closed 3-manifolds and of spin-c 6-manifolds with H_1 = 0 and H-flux, torsion in H^3 included, the T-duality exchange for circle bundles over surfaces, and the Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch identities of the paper, by Smith normal forms in exact arithmetic (45 checks).
